options.text: i - d, ii - c, iii - b, iv - a
i - a, ii - b, iii - c, iv - d
i - b, ii - c, iii - a, iv - d
i - c, ii - a, iii - b, iv - d

solution:
The correct answer is__** "i - c, ii - a, iii - b, iv - d".**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jhuming**:-

 
 
• It is a type of shifting agriculture practiced in the North Eastern region of India.
 
 
 
• **Dahiya**:-
 
 
• It is a type of shifting agriculture practiced in Madhya Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Penda:-**
 
 
• It is a type of shifting agriculture practiced in Andhra Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Kumari:-**
 
 
• It is a type of shifting agriculture practiced in the Western Ghats.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shifting agriculture:-**

 
 
• It is a traditional method of farming where farmers move from one place to another after a few years to allow the land to regenerate.
